changelog:
- Plugin 0.3.1: call the static pages "HTML" in the admin (menu, boxes, notices, guide)
- Plugin 0.3.0: updates from GitHub releases (Update now), release workflow
- CI: build-blog workflow (WordPress content -> Astro -> Netlify) and docs
- Plugin: Astro menu, Content/Styles/Google/Guide tabs, Articles API, PageSpeed, Netlify connect
- Admin UI: Vue 3 + Naive UI app for the Astro screens
- Frontend: WordPress-editable site content, styles and {variable} descriptions
- Plugin: record and show build status (building/success/failed) via /build-status callback
- Frontend: skip WP data memoisation in astro dev so edits show on refresh
- Plugin: full-width article role, Astro template picker, settings link and copy tweaks
- Add repo CLAUDE.md; refresh README for the multi-site setup
- wp-astro v0.2.0: Blog front role, remote serve mode, multi-site frontend
- Header: Our Services → /service-page-overview/; report: staging Lighthouse 100/100 results
- Perf: hero AVIF preload, quality 60, upright-only fonts, self-hosted YouTube thumb
- Perf/a11y: text-only CTA token (4.5:1), YouTube facade, body images via astro:assets, asset cache headers
- CTA colour token: #40ae96 -> #0ba282
- Article template redesign + staging deploy workflow
- Article page: layout rhythm, byline, header, FAQ, references, related
- Fix body text colour: --font-color-base-100 typo -> --color-base-100
- Article body: reading-width column, carded TL;DR, tighter heading scale
- Phase 2: TOC number inherits link colour (matches label, transitions on hover)
- Phase 2: TOC numbered via CSS counter (works with grid; number in --color-base-100, label muted); 1.5em number column
- Phase 2: TOC styles scoped to .wa-widget ol / .wa-widget ol a (no .wa-toc class)
- Phase 2: TOC list styles (.wa-toc ol grid gap, .wa-toc a small muted + colour hover); disable stylelint no-descending-specificity (false positives with layered component CSS)
- Phase 2: CTA arrow — static vertical nudge via margin-block-start (translate stays hover-only, no jump)
- Phase 2: fix CTA arrow — recreate public/icons/arrow-icon-cta-button-hover.svg, absolute mask URL, add -webkit-mask
- Phase 2: CTA buttons — .wa-btn shell + --primary/--secondary variants (colours only differ); sliding hover fill via ::before, arrow via ::after mask(/icons/arrow.svg), reduced-motion; CTA + --ease-out tokens
- Phase 2: swap in real Stars + GoogleG SVGs; aligned component structure (both: {...Astro.props}, viewBox, aria-hidden, no fixed size); stars DRY via translated map
- Phase 2: add public/icons/arrow.svg (placeholder) for CSS mask use on CTA hover
- Phase 2: inline icon components (Stars, GoogleG) in src/components/icons/; add Google-reviews link above the sidebar CTA h3 (one flex line, SVGs inlined in HTML)
- Phase 2: cap running text at --measure (68ch) on .wa-tldr/.wa-prose; drop dead justify-content:space-between (no-op with 1fr main track)
